entries.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning: Evidence from high school mathematics
entries.claim_text: Students with unguarded GPT-4 access performed 17% worse on the independent exam than the control group, despite higher practice performance.
entries.effect_summary: negative_17_percent_on_independent_exam

entries.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning: Evidence from high school mathematics
entries.claim_text: Guardrail design of the AI tutor (hints instead of answers, teacher-informed prompts) largely eliminated the negative learning effect.
entries.effect_summary: negative effect essentially eradicated, no positive effect observed

entries.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning: Evidence from high school mathematics
entries.claim_text: Access to GPT-4 during practice improves task performance (48% for GPT Base, 127% for GPT Tutor) — but this task performance does not transfer to independent exam performance.
entries.effect_summary: 48-127 percent improvement on practice problems

entries.claim_text: ChatGPT as a formative feedback tool produced a significant positive impact on students' academic writing skills with positive student perceptions.
entries.effect_summary: significant positive impact on writing skills

entries.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning: Evidence from high school mathematics
entries.claim_text: Access to GPT-4 during practice substantially improves practice problem performance (+48% for unguarded GPT Base, +127% for guardrailed GPT Tutor), but these task-performance gains do not transfer to independent exam performance.
entries.effect_summary: positive_48_to_127_percent_on_practice_problems

entries.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning: Evidence from high school mathematics
entries.claim_text: Students using unguarded GPT-4 (GPT Base, general chat) performed 17% worse on the independent exam than the control group despite higher practice performance — unguarded generative AI harms learning.
entries.effect_summary: negative_17_percent_on_independent_exam

entries.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning: Evidence from high school mathematics
entries.claim_text: Guardrail design of the AI tutor (hints and guidance instead of direct answers, teacher-informed prompts) largely eliminated the negative learning effect on the independent exam.
entries.effect_summary: negative_effect_essentially_eliminated_no_positive_effect_observed

entries.claim_text: Unguarded generative AI access (GPT Base) improved practice performance (+48%) but lowered independent exam performance by 17% relative to control — contradicting the claim that AI access reliably improves independent performance.

entries.title: Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning: Evidence from high school mathematics

entries.claim_text: Task performance during practice improves sharply with AI access (+48% GPT Base, +127% GPT Tutor), yet these gains do not transfer to independent exam performance — assignment/writing scores must not be equated with independent ability.

coverage_note: 内置证据库：由 30 份金标准标注（benchmarks/annotations/gold-Q01..Q30 的 key_claims/key_supporting_sources/known_contradictions/correct_outcome_types）+ 3 个示例工作流 evidence.jsonl（ai-coding-assistant / ai-tutor / ai-writing-assistant）抽取生成；按 (source_id, outcome_token, claim_text) 去重合并。direction 语义为采纳方向：support=支持采纳（初步裁决=>pilot），contradict=反对采纳（=>reject），neutral=中性；金标准条目按 expected_decision_range 粗粒度映射方向（纯 reject 问题反向映射），conflict 与混合方向问题的单条断言方向可能不精确。仅用于离线初步裁决（preliminary，保守），从不直接给出 adopt。
